mapper.select: SELECT code_group AS codeGroup, MAX(code_group_description_zh_tw) AS codeGroupDescription, code_field AS codeField, MAX(code_field_description_zh_tw) AS codeFieldDescription FROM new_contract.code_definition WHERE active_flag = 'Y' AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY code_group, code_field ORDER BY code_group, code_field

SELECT code_value AS code, code_description_zh_tw AS description, code_description_en AS descriptionEn, classification_code AS classificationCode, classification_description_zh_tw AS classificationDescription, breakdown_code AS breakdownCode, breakdown_description_zh_tw AS breakdownDescription, nature_of_work_zh_tw AS natureOfWork, source_version AS sourceVersion FROM new_contract.code_definition WHERE code_group = #{codeGroup} AND code_field = #{codeField} AND active_flag = 'Y' AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY display_order, code_value

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_contract.code_definition WHERE code_group = #{codeGroup} AND code_field = #{codeField} AND active_flag = 'Y' AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE)
AND (code_value LIKE CONCAT(#{query}, '%') OR code_description_zh_tw LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%'))
